newsitem.title: ESTONIA: UHIS LAUNCHES LATVIA LEASING AUTUMN.
newsitem.headline: UHIS LAUNCHES LATVIA LEASING AUTUMN.

text.p: Uhispank hopes to launch its Latvian leasing subsidiary this autumn, the chairman of its leasing arm Marek Puidak said on Friday.
The bank will launch the company without partners in Latvia, Puidak told Reuters.
"The Latvian market is concentrated and close to Estonia," Puidak said, adding that in Lithuania it is looking for strategic partners to set up a company.
"The Lithuanian market is divided between four to five bigger towns...it would not be sensible for an Estonian company to open offices in every bigger town" he added.
Uhisliising has a 20 percent market share in Estonia. It has also registered a subsidiary in St Peterburg which will start operating in the coming weeks after it has received a licence.
